# Bundled QR decoder

jsQR 1.4.0, unchanged from `jsqr@1.4.0` on npm.
Upstream: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
License: Apache-2.0; see jsQR-LICENSE.txt.
SHA-256 of jsQR-1.4.0.js: `bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859`.

Loaded only when the operator selects Scan QR code. Camera frames are decoded
locally and are never uploaded. No external CDN or QR service is used.
